sma_definition: Mean of last 10 completed calendar-month-end adjusted closes, INCLUDING current signal month
timing: Update at month-end close; execute first subsequent session open; no intramonth response
equality: Retain prior target; initial warmup target cash until a strict crossing
warmup: 1998–1999 month ends; each window inherits last completed monthly signal before start, but fresh initial capital
contributions: Same as prior study; monthly at first session open starting February; invest new cash only if target is long
allocation: 100% SPY or 100% cash, no shorting or leverage; fractionally modeled units
costs: Apply stated adverse bps to BOTH purchases AND sales; zero commission and no taxes are project scenarios
cash_proxy: Same lagged DGS3MO ACT/365 yield-accrual proxy as prior experiment; not actual bill returns or account yield
dividends: Same current-vintage Yahoo adjusted OHLC total-return proxy; not exact pay-date DRIP

paper.title: A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation
paper.author: Mebane T. Faber
paper.pdf_self_reported_version: February 2013 update; May 2006 working paper, Spring 2007 publication, February 2009 update also listed
paper.difference: Original states signal-day close execution and total-return series/cash T-bills; this uses next open, SPY instead of GFD index, yield proxy and contributions

outputs: completed and censored peak-to-recovery durations in calendar days
